title: Stop arms are repository contract fields, off in KRN itself
body:
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-skills-1115l.md slice 5 (operator 2026-11-15: keep red-first outside, drop it in KRN's own lanes; one universal system)
Why: lanes in this repository write a dozen `Clause N: not reproducible` lines per PR for the test-first and clause arms (t-4kqzdw0, t-bxw0ben, t-8tvfrbs, t-781d08h reports); the switch must be a contract option any repository may set, not a KRN branch.
Outcome: krn.json gains "arms": {"red-first": bool, "clauses": bool}, default on; src/repo/contract.ts reads it, src/hook/stop.ts and src/cli/lane-run/steps.ts honour it, the lead skill says "the arms the contract enables"; this repository's krn.json sets both false.
Files: src/repo/contract.ts, src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/lane-run/steps.ts, krn.json, .agents/skills/krn-lead/lanes.md
Proof: a lane run in this repository ends without clause lines; an outside row still prints red-first 1.
Predicted: proof clauses-total <= 0
